REMOVAL OF CLUTCH UNIT

1. REMOVE TRANSMISSION (See pages MT·3, 4)
NOTE: Do not drain the transmission oil.

2. REMOVE CLUTCH COVER AND DISC
(a) Loosen the set bolts one turn at a time until spring tension is released.
(b) Remove the set bolts, and pull off the clutch assembly.

3. REMOVE BEARING, HUB AND FORK FROM TRANSMISSION
(a) Remove the clips, and pull off the bearing and hub.
(b) Remove the fork and boot.
